/* buyer.mpso."selectAekyReList" */ SELECT A.BUYER, A.QUOTATION_NO, A.QUOTATION_SEQ, A.BUYER_ITEM_NO, A.DESCRIPTION, A.SPECIFICATION, 'KRW' AS CUR, A.UNIT_MEASURE, A.BTOA_USER_DEPT, TRIM(TO_CHAR(DECODE(A.ITEM_QTY,0,1,NVL(A.ITEM_QTY,1)),'999,999,999,999,999')) AS ITEM_QTY, TRIM(TO_CHAR(A.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE,'999,999,999,999,999')) AS PRICE, TRIM(TO_CHAR((DECODE(A.ITEM_QTY,0,1,TRIM(NVL(A.ITEM_QTY,1))) * A.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE) ,'999,999,999,999,999')) AS AMT, (SELECT TRIM(TO_CHAR(SUM((DECODE(ITEM_QTY,0,1,NVL(ITEM_QTY,1)) * ATOB_UNIT_PRICE)),'999,999,999,999,999')) FROM KEPRQDT WHERE BUYER = A.BUYER AND GW_NO = A.GW_NO) AS TOT_AMT, (SELECT TO_CHAR(COUNT(*)) FROM KEPRQDT WHERE BUYER = A.BUYER AND GW_NO = A.GW_NO) AS TOT_CNT FROM KEPRQDT A , ICOMCMPY B WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.BUYER = #{buyer} AND A.GW_NO = (SELECT KEY_1 FROM ICOMTRGW WHERE COM_CODE = #{buyer} AND TARGET = #{ak_docu_no}) AND A.BUYER = B.COM_CODE

/* buyer.mpso.selectAekyReAppInfo */ SELECT COMPANY, DOCU_NO, DOCU_TITLE, DOCU_CONT, USER_ID, USER_NM, TO_CHAR(START_DATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS APP_DATE, GET_CSTMR_DEAL_STTMN_NO(COMPANY) AS APPR_ID FROM ICOGDOCU WHERE (COMPANY, DOCU_NO) IN ( SELECT COM_CODE, TARGET FROM ICOMTRGW WHERE DOC_NAME = 'NS' AND COM_CODE = #{buyer} AND TARGET = #{ak_docu_no})
